instruction: Change the name of the 'project_backup_v1' folder on the Desktop to 'project_backup_v2'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Rename folder with different naming pattern (project_backup_v1 -> project_backup_v2). Similar difficulty to original - simple folder rename operation on Desktop. Evaluator checks if renamed folder exists using shell command.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks both conditions for a rename operation - old folder 'project_backup_v1' must NOT exist AND new folder 'project_backup_v2' must exist
Correct logic flow: Uses bash AND operator (&&) to ensure both conditions are true, which accurately represents a rename operation semantic
No false positives: Will correctly reject copy operations, partial operations, or no operations - only passes when true rename has occurred
Correct expected value: 'Rename successful.\n' matches the command output on success
Appropriate getter: vm_command_line with filesystem check is the correct approach for verifying folder operations
Addresses previous issues: All concerns from earlier judgment (score 0.5) have been resolved - the command now verifies both folder absence and presence
